correctness.rationale: The circular-order lemma forces unique three-block anchors. Longest cross-block arc inequalities are independent and supply exactly m-1 augmentation positions; choosing d positions gives binomial(m-1,d) cells per anchor, and summing m(m+1)/2 anchor-gap choices per starting residue proves all counts. Independent complete arc enumeration agrees with anchored enumeration at n=5,7,9,11,13,15. No homotopy/integer-chain claim is made.

value.rationale: The unique Boolean anchor stratification gives the full naturally defined regular-CW face polynomial for all odd orders, as well as exact top dimension, purity and cellular orbit counts. These cellular data are not implied by homotopy, control the full chain-module sizes and allow constructive enumeration for subsequent equivariant and Morse investigations. The result is an infinite-family structural classification rather than a minor extra numerical case.
